name: Pre-Arranged Employment Visa (9(g)) with Alien Employment Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires the employer to first obtain an Alien Employment Permit (AEP) from the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), demonstrating the role cannot reasonably be filled by a qualified Filipino, before petitioning the Bureau of Immigration for the 9(g) visa itself.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a job offer from a Philippine employer willing to obtain the DOLE AEP before filing the BI 9(g) petition.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires medical clearance (BOQ Form 11), police clearance from both the home country and the Philippine NBI, and a Bureau of Immigration clearance certificate.
requirements.fix_path: Complete the required medical and police clearances.

evidence_required.document: Employment contract and employer sponsorship documentation
Medical clearance (BOQ Form 11), home-country and NBI police clearances, BI Clearance Certificate

outcome.duration_length: 1-3 years, tied to the employment contract, renewable

sources.title: Work Visa Philippines -- Immigration Requirements in the Philippines: A 2026 Guide for Foreign Nationals, describing the AEP-to-9(g) two-step DOLE/BI process

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of a DOLE or Bureau of Immigration page was achieved for this route in this research pass, despite consistent cross-corroboration of the two-agency (DOLE then BI) sequence across multiple sources. STRUCTURAL FINDING: this is a genuine two-agency, two-step process -- DOLE's Alien Employment Permit functions as a labour-market test (broadly similar in spirit to labour-market tests seen in Poland's and other countries' work-sponsored routes elsewhere in this dataset), and only after the AEP is secured does the employer petition the Bureau of Immigration separately for the 9(g) visa itself; the full sequence is commonly cited as taking 2-3 months end-to-end. Foreign employees of PEZA-accredited economic-zone locators can instead use a streamlined 47(a)(2) or Special Working Visa processed through the zone's own one-stop shop, bypassing the standard DOLE/BI sequence -- not modeled as a separate route file here given the scope of this initial build, but flagged as a real, meaningfully faster parallel channel for zone-based employers specifically. pr_after_months and citizenship_after_months use general estimated tracks pending confirmation of the specific years-of-9(g)-status-held threshold against ph_permanent_resident_visa's Quota Immigrant Visa criteria.
